issues.issue: Warrant proceeds of 1,040,207 are netted into other_financing. The extractor's SID rule sends warrant/bond proceeds to debt_proceeds, and SID 353 in this batch puts its warrants issued in debt_proceeds. The identity still holds, but the treatment is inconsistent across reports.
Motor vehicle tax distributed to the SID could be 'motor vehicle tax' (only pro-rate is state aid). Defensible because the label says 'State'. The same applies to detail[2] (other state aid).
